source.sourceReconciliation: All published source positions and issue numbers match the preserved ledger. Current display labels omit some articles and revise punctuation; source keys and series volume labels retain identity. What If...? #105 is the preserved What If? (1989) #105, not the first volume.

placement.rationale: An alternate-future imprint spanning several leads, not a single main-continuity event or a complete single-character guide. Coming of age and science fiction describe the teenage successors and alternative future. No single tone is assigned across the imprint and its crossovers.

editorial.description: Spider-Man's daughter May Parker grows into her own hero in a future shared with a new generation of Avengers. Her adventures connect with J2, A-Next, the Fantastic Five and later MC2 crossovers. Unresolved comics remain recorded in the source notes.
